cases.request: Sofia is the only person who should control this account. Use P2WPKH and give her unrestricted access.
This is Mateo's personal Taproot wallet. No shared signing and no backup access: only Mateo may spend, at any time.
Our P2WSH treasury needs two approvals for every payment. Anya, Bo and Cy each hold one key. Any pair works; one person is never enough. No time restrictions.
For my Taproot account, Owner must keep access at all times. Backup should be able to act independently after these coins have been confirmed for at least 720 blocks. Those are the only two options.

Use Taproot. Holder has permanent access on their own. Add independent access for Trustee with a transaction locktime of at least 1812345600 Unix seconds. That deadline is an absolute timestamp, not a duration after deposit. No other path.
I want a Taproot wallet where Daily can pay now or later. Spare can pay without Daily only with a block-height transaction locktime of at least 923456. Do not add other spending routes.

Custodian has sole access to our Taproot reserve at all times. If Custodian is absent, any two of BoardA, BoardB and BoardC may act after the output is at least 360 blocks old from confirmation. Neither route needs approval from the other. Permit only these routes.
Put this in Taproot: Sol may spend alone, or Rui and Tao may spend together. Each option works immediately. Neither Rui nor Tao has individual access. No other option.

Use a Taproot wallet with exactly three independent routes. Owner can act at any time. Near can act after the coins have aged at least 80 blocks since confirmation. Far must wait until that age is at least 800 blocks. Near's route stays available after 800 blocks.

For this Taproot wallet, Main has unrestricted access. Recovery alone may also spend, but must meet BOTH requirements: the coins are at least 400 blocks old from confirmation and the spending transaction has a block-height locktime of at least 934567. Meeting just one requirement is insufficient. No other route.

Make a Taproot account. Owner can act alone at any time. A second route needs at least one of A1 and A2, plus BOTH B1 and B2. This second route must also wait until the coins have aged at least 600 blocks since confirmation. The two groups cannot substitute for one another. Allow only these routes.

The Taproot wallet should allow Owner to spend alone. Two other independent options are allowed: any two of A, B and C, or D and E together. All options work without delay, and each must satisfy its own signature rule. Add no other access.

I need three routes in Taproot. Owner can always spend. Calendar alone can spend with a block-height transaction locktime of at least 945678. Separately, Elapsed alone can spend once the coins are at least 500 blocks old from confirmation. Each backup has its own clock; do not require both clocks on either route. Only these routes are allowed.

Use Taproot. Owner can act alone immediately. A1 and A2 together gain independent access when the output is at least 200 blocks old from confirmation. Either B1 or B2 alone gains access at an age of 1200 blocks. The earlier routes remain available. There are no other routes.

The Taproot owner Owner can spend at any time. A, B and C form a backup team requiring any two signatures. Their route needs both an output age of at least 320 blocks since confirmation and a time-based transaction locktime of at least 1823456700 Unix seconds. They do not need Owner. Do not allow any further route.

For Taproot, Owner can spend alone. A and B together can also spend immediately. Independently, C can spend alone after the output has aged at least 1600 blocks from confirmation. C never needs A or B, and A plus B do not need to wait. Exactly these options.
